issues.explanation: Flips is_active through UpdateQueue without an explicit $this->authorize('update', $queue); relies solely on the action for authorization, violating authorize-every-action.
Mutating grant/revoke paths delegate to SetQueueAccess without an explicit $this->authorize('manageAccess', $queue) in the component; defense-in-depth authorization is missing.

conventions.evidence: app/Livewire/Entity/Queues.php:137 uses CreateQueue/UpdateQueue/SetQueueAccess; app/Livewire/Entity/Serve.php:406 uses CallNextTicket; #[Validate] + validateOnly used; docs updated in CHANGELOG.md:9 and docs/business-rules.md:492; but toggleActive (Queues.php:225) and setAccess (Queues.php:300) lack $this->authorize

readability.evidence: app/Livewire/Entity/Queues.php:307 resetNested, app/Livewire/Entity/Serve.php:436 callableQueues / 455 waitingTickets; small focused methods and clear names matching sibling style

requirements.evidence: resources/views/livewire/entity/queues.blade.php:712 wire:click="openQueue()" list-only; app/Livewire/Entity/Queues.php:200 slug re-derived via Str::slug; app/Livewire/Entity/Serve.php:375 defaults to first callable queue, :395 scoped findOrFail, :398 rate-limit, :404-415 exception mapping; setActiveTab guards members|invites; routes entity.queues/serve; all lang keys present

scope.evidence: change.diff adds only queues/serve pages, members tabs, navbar entries, lang keys, docs CHANGELOG/business-rules and directly required test updates; no unrelated refactors

security.evidence: Scoped resolution via $entity->queues()->findOrFail in Queues.php:156,172,189,213,227,236,301 and Serve.php:395; render uses find returning null for tampered ids; {{ }} escaping; #[Locked] entity/lastCalledTicketId; but toggleActive and grant/revoke lack explicit $this->authorize

simplicity.evidence: app/Livewire/Entity/Queues.php:283 accessGrants and app/Livewire/Entity/Serve.php:436 callableQueues reuse Eloquent + policies; no service layers or speculative abstractions

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/Entity/QueuesPageTest.php:1124 403, :1213 non-manager create forbidden, :1365 foreign ids ModelNotFound, :1398 tampered disclosure; tests/Feature/Entity/ServePanelTest.php:1667 forbidden without grant, :1700 rate limit, :1693 locked property, :1680 invalid mode

review.summary: Adds Queues management and Serve attendant panel on the domain actions with scoped-id handling, members tabs, navbar entries, translations, and thorough Pest coverage. Requirements, tests, simplicity, readability and scope are strong, but toggleActive and grant/revoke lack explicit component-side authorization, so needs changes before merging.
